headlines.description: — With the Dallas Cowboys trailing by three points and on the verge of yet another fourth-quarter collapse, Dak Prescott needed 29 seconds to bail them out.
headlines.shortLinkText: Javonte Williams' late TD run helps Cowboys avoid another 4th-quarter collapse and beat Colts 27-23

events.name: New York Jets at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes walked off the field dangling his right arm, which had been bent grotesquely on a strip-sack by the Jets' David Bailey, and for the briefest of moments a pall seemed to descend over Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kenneth Walker scores 3 TDs as the Chiefs roll past the woeful Jets 35-12 to end their 2-game skid

events.name: Detroit Lions at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions have repeated a mantra all week in the aftermath of a scary neck injury to All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions grind past Dolphins 19-9 as Jahmyr Gibbs scores and Jake Bates makes 4 field goals

events.name: Cleveland Browns at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Saints second-year quarterback Tyler Shough likes to think he has a refined and thoughtful approach to remaining calm and in control in the clutch.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints hold on for a 23-22 overtime victory over the Browns by stopping a 2-point conversion

events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — J.J. McCarthy may as well have been any New York Giants fan nervously watching on TV as the injured quarterback tossed a football to keep warm and paced around the locker room.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston, McCarthy combine to lead Giants to 19-11 win and hand Eagles 7th straight loss

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — There's still room for growth from the star-studded Rams, but they're starting to show again why they were a preseason Super Bowl favorite.
headlines.shortLinkText: Puka Nacua, Myles Garrett lead Rams to 20-13 win over Commanders

events.name: Denver Broncos at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — The Denver Broncos continue to know how to win close games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Nix throws for 2 TDs, Broncos win key challenge to beat Panthers 26-21 for fifth straight victory

events.name: Houston Texans at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — C.J. Stroud had been feeling lousy all week, barely practiced and woke up with chills on game day. Then he had his version of Michael Jordan's flu game.
headlines.shortLinkText: C.J. Stroud tosses 5 TD passes as Texans rout winless Chargers 44-22. LA finally scores a TD

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — If Jordan Love has played a better game than he did on Sunday, he can't remember it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love accounts for 4 touchdowns, Packers force 4 turnovers in 45-27 win over Patriots

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Jaden Dugger set the tone for the second half when he returned an interception from Kirk Cousins on the first play for a touchdown.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers capitalize on 5 2nd-half takeaways to cruise past Raiders 38-17

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — AJ Barner's breakout came just when the Seahawks needed it.
headlines.shortLinkText: AJ Barner has a TD catch and runs for a score in Seahawks' 17-3 win over Cardinals

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Caleb Williams and the Chicago Bears played one of their worst games of the season — and won.
headlines.shortLinkText: Williams connects with Loveland to set up Santos' winning field goal as Bears edge Buccaneers 27-24

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: - The Buffalo Bills knew they weren't bound for many style points or likely to reach their league-leading scoring average against Minnesota's relentlessly...
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen and the Bills move to 7-1 with a 23-6 win over the sputtering Vikings

events.name: Washington Commanders at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Even after Jayden Daniels threw two interceptions and it looked like the Washington Commanders were hurtling toward a painful loss at the New York Giants, teammates remembered what it was like when the franchise quarterback burst onto the scene in...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayden Daniels and Commanders rally to stun the Giants 24-21 and keep their hopes alive

events.name: New England Patriots at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Amon-Ra St. Brown wore lederhosen, carried a German flag onto the field, and then went out and scored two touchdowns.
headlines.shortLinkText: St. Brown and Gibbs score 2 TDs each in Lions' 35-10 rout of Patriots after Maye injured in Munich

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Some new names had the Kansas City Chiefs looking very young — and very strong.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws 5 TD passes and rookie Johnson runs for 101 yards as Chiefs overwhelm Falcons 35-13

events.name: Houston Texans at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Deshaun Watson can talk all he wants about how playing the Houston Texans is just another game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deshaun Watson throws for 312 yards against his old team as the Browns rally past the Texans 27-24

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Kirk Cousins began his second stint with Minnesota by showing just how much of a difference he can make for the Vikings' offense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kirk Cousins has triumphant return as Vikings sack Jordan Love 8 times in 30-10 win over Packers

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence has found a way to play even better, and he's elevating the Jacksonville offense right along with him.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Lawrence lights up the Titans as the Jaguars roll 40-23 for a sixth win in 7 games

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — The Indianapolis Colts got the respite they needed.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts' struggling offense does just enough to beat Dolphins 24-22 and snap 5-game skid

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Chuba Hubbard made long gains out of short passes, pushed through tacklers and pulled the mistake-prone Carolina Panthers out of a three-game slide.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hubbard helps the Panthers top the Saints, 20-17, and retain first place in the NFC South

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills are off to the franchise's best start in 35 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen powers Bills past Jets 31-12 for best start in 35 years. New York loses Geno Smith twice

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — The lead-up to Sunday's Seattle-Las Vegas matchup was almost all about Fernando Mendoza, at last receiving his first start as the Raiders' quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks beat Raiders 21-13 as Drew Lock throws for 2 TDs and Seattle sacks Fernando Mendoza 6 times

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Beaux Limmer was snapping the ball, Xavier Smith and Davis Allen were catching it and Kamren Kinchens came up with a key interception.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams win their 4th straight game, overcoming a slow start to crush the Cardinals 34-6

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Christian McCaffrey's first long touchdown catch was straight out of the schoolyard, the second a Kyle Shanahan special for the San Francisco 49ers.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCaffrey's TDs of 74 and 66 yards and Samuel's 70-yard score help 49ers beat Cowboys 46-40

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Joe Burrow and the Cincinnati Bengals didn't wither under the prime-time spotlight.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Burrow and Bengals dominate Steelers 38-18 to take AFC North lead alone

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — The Los Angeles Chargers finally won a game — with the type of smashmouth performance that has brought Jim Harbaugh so much success during his coaching career.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers bully the Ravens at the line of scrimmage and earn their first win of the season, 23-20

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — C.J. Stroud had another big game to help the Houston Texans finally get a victory at home.
headlines.shortLinkText: C.J. Stroud throws for 3 TDs as the Texans roll past the Colts 26-3

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Stingy as Buffalo has been while not allowing a touchdown over the past 15-plus quarters, defensive tackle Deone Walker remains unsatisfied.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills' defense feasts in 26-9 win over injury-depleted Dolphins

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Jeffery Simmons delivered once again. That blockbuster trade for the All-Pro defensive tackle is looking like the appropriate price at the moment.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jeffery Simmons gets 3 sacks as the Chicago Bears beat the New Orleans Saints 21-13

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — When one touchdown became two and three and so on, all the way to six, Dak Prescott said the conversation was the same for the offense of the Dallas Cowboys: Just keeping doing it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak Prescott accounts for 5 TDs as the Cowboys roll to a 51-30 victory over the Titans

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions are finding their groove, leaning on a balanced attack offensively and a steadily improving defense that hasn't been hurt by the losses of
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff throws 2 TDs, Jahmyr Gibbs runs for 2 more and Lions beat Bucs 31-21 for 6th straight win

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes slinging touchdown passes to Travis Kelce.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws 3 TD passes, Kelce catches 2 of them, as KC routs Cardinals 34-7 for 3rd straight win

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — Dave Canales is like most NFL coaches — he wants to keep his team's focus on the next game and avoid any potential outside distractions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryce Young, Chuba Hubbard help Panthers add to NFC South lead with 35-33 victory over the Ravens

events.name: New York Jets at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Mired in a losing season, New York Jets quarterback Geno Smith's efficiency has been largely overlooked with the offense lagging. Sterling Shepard helped change that Sunday, catching two touchdown passes from Smith and potentially earning himself a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets score on first 5 drives and edge Chargers 27-24 to snap 5-game skid

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Forty years after his retirement from football and 48 hours after his death at age 75, the Denver Broncos set aside a game ball for Tom Jackson...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jonah Coleman powers Broncos past Raiders 38-24 as Denver honors the late Tom Jackson

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at New York Giants

headlines.description: — After J.J. McCarthy and the New York Giants sputtered for much of the fourth quarter, Jaguars coach Liam Coen decided to kick a late field goal because he was confident Jacksonville would get the ball back with a chance to win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants intercept Trevor Lawrence twice and hold on to beat the Jaguars 23-18

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Brock Purdy and the San Francisco 49ers offense turned the much ballyhooed matchup between one of the game's top offenses and the stingiest defenses into...
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Purdy carves up the Vikings' D with 3 TD passes in the 49ers' 35-10 win in Mexico City

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Jayden Daniels and the Commanders had scored on five consecutive drives, all of them covering 50 yards or more. But their last possession was the most daunting.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayden Daniels rallies Commanders in final seconds to set up winning kick in 22-20 win over Bengals
